performance_issues.description: LIKE query on LOWER(full_name) cannot use index efficiently
performance_issues.impact: Full table scan on full_name column for keyword searches
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider adding a functional index on LOWER(full_name) or using full-text search

optimization_recommendations.description: Add index on lower(full_name) for keyword search performance
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Faster keyword searches on large user tables

resource_load.note: 1 user lookup + visibility check (follow + team_user queries for private users)
No DB queries - uses pre-loaded ctx.Doer from auth middleware
1 user lookup + 1 aggregation query on action table

performance_issues.description: Heatmap data is computed on every request with a heavy aggregation query over ~1 year of action data
performance_issues.impact: Expensive GROUP BY query on action table for each request
performance_issues.code_snippet: Select(groupBy+" AS timestamp, count(user_id) as contributions").Table("action")
performance_issues.recommendation: Cache heatmap results with short TTL (5-15 min) since data changes infrequently

performance_issues.description: The heatmap query filters on created_unix with a range condition but also needs user_id filter from the ActivityQueryCondition
performance_issues.impact: May not use optimal index for the combined user_id + created_unix filter
performance_issues.recommendation: Ensure composite index on action(user_id, created_unix) exists

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache heatmap results per user with 5-15 minute TTL
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use cache.StringCache with key 'heatmap:{user_id}' and invalidate on new actions

optimization_recommendations.description: Add composite index on action(user_id, created_unix)
optimization_recommendations.implementation: CREATE INDEX idx_action_user_created ON action(user_id, created_unix)

resource_load.note: 1 user lookup + 1 count + 1 action query + N LoadAttributes queries (users, repos) + N permission checks

performance_issues.description: ToActivities calls GetDoerRepoPermission for each action's repo individually
performance_issues.impact: For a page of 30 actions across different repos, this generates up to 30 additional permission queries
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch permission checks or cache repo permissions per request

performance_issues.description: Activity feeds are queried from DB on every request with no caching layer
performance_issues.impact: Repeated expensive queries for popular user profiles
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider short-lived cache for feed results (1-5 min TTL)

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch repo permission checks in ToActivities instead of per-action
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce N permission queries to 1 batch query for unique repos
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Collect unique repo IDs, batch-fetch permissions, then map to each activity

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache activity feed results with short TTL
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce DB load for frequently accessed user profiles
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Cache serialized feed response with key 'feeds:{user_id}:{page}:{date}'

resource_load.note: 1 image processing + 1 DB update + 1 storage write

performance_issues.description: Image processing (decode, crop, resize, encode) happens synchronously on the request thread
performance_issues.impact: Large images may block the request thread during processing
performance_issues.recommendation: Acceptable for avatar sizes; MaxWidth/MaxHeight limits prevent extreme cases
